title: Tasty Bite

{{Short description|Indian-American preserved food}} {{Infobox company | name = Tasty Bite Eatables | logo = Tasty bite logo.png | logo_size = 100px | type = [[Public company|Public]] | traded_as = {{ubl|{{NSE|TASTYBITE}}|{{BSE|519091}}}} | founded = 1995 | hq_location = [[Pune]], [[India]]
[[Stamford, Connecticut]], United States | key_people = Ashok Vasudevan (Chief Executive) | industry = Consumer packaged goods | products = Ready-to-eat meals, noodles, rice | revenue = | operating_income = | net_income = | num_employees = | subsidiaries = Tasty Bite Edibles, Ltd. | parent = [[Mars, Incorporated]] | website = [http://www.tastybite.com tastybite.com] | footnotes = }} '''Tasty Bite''' is an Indian-American [[preserved food]] manufacturer, producing ready-to-eat [[India]]n and [[pan-Asian]] food products. The products require no refrigeration. Tasty Bite was founded in 1996. Its products are available in every state in the U.S. and are sold in most American grocery chains. In August 2017, a majority of the owner company of Tasty Bite was acquired by [[Mars, Incorporated]]. {{cite web | url=https://gbr.mars.com/news-and-stories/press-releases/food-acquires-tasty-bite | title=Mars Food to Acquire Majority Stake in Tasty Bite | publisher=Mars, Inc. | accessdate=27 May 2020}} ==Preparation and packaging== Tasty Bite meals are sealed in a multi-layer [[retort pouch]] and have a [[shelf life]] of up to 18 months. During the manufacturing process, the pouches are filled with food, sealed, and cooked in a retort oven under high temperature and pressure. Tasty Bite products are manufactured at its [[Bhandgaon]] plant in India. The vegetables used are partially grown on a private farm owned and managed by the company, though the rest of the vegetables are procured through traders from local markets. ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== * [http://www.tastybite.com Official site] * [http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/2003/03/05/stories/2003030501700600.htm (The Hindu Business Line) Tasty Bite plans foray into curry pastes] {{Portal|Companies}} [[Category:Brand name snack foods]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]]
